rationale: No existing spec exercises the HTTP-409 dashboard save-conflict dialog (DashboardSaveConflictDialog / useDashboardSaveConflict). The closest match, dashboard-panel-unsaved-changes.spec.js, covers a different feature: the native window.confirm leave-guard when discarding the panel editor with unsaved edits. There is no spec, page object, or API helper for the 409 conflict flow, so a brand-new spec (per run-context spec_path) must be created and registered under the Dashboards-Core shard in ci_matrix.json.
